example.title: Jenkins culvert, county road M over an ephemeral stream east of county road 22

brief: Three-barrel WPA stone arch culvert of 1938 under a gravel section-line road: three semicircular arches of about 5-6 ft span with alternating buff and pink limestone voussoirs, squared-block limestone walls in even courses, and a low solid parapet with plain coping level with the road on both sides; the end post of the parapet is cut 'WPA 1938'. Yellow-and-black hazard markers stand at the parapet ends. Open short-grass prairie and fields, dry grassy channel.

traits.railing_detail: low solid stone parapet with coping
